# OpenJarvis attribution and source

Apollo integrates OpenJarvis, copyright its respective contributors, under
Apache License 2.0. A copy is supplied as `OpenJarvis-LICENSE.txt`.

- Original repository: https://github.com/open-jarvis/OpenJarvis
- Pinned revision: `13706f2b5b5ba6cac9ad31bc575d9e115213784f`
- Complete original source: `vendor/openjarvis` (Git submodule).
- The source is unmodified. Apollo-specific adapters are `apollo_openjarvis.py`,
  `openjarvis_worker.py`, `apollo_openjarvis_chat.py`, `apollo_openjarvis_ui.py`
  and `modules/openjarvis/`.
- Optional model weights and third-party dependencies retain their own licences.

The pinned source includes upstream native/Rust backends, frontend, agents,
tools, learning and evaluation code. Inclusion is not a claim that every
external account, accelerator, native extension or optional backend is ready
on the current computer.
